recent.text: The Rangers have traded G Spencer Martin to Chicago for G Arvid Soderblom. Soderblom, 27, was recently sent down by Chicago to their AHL Rockford team. He goes to AHL Hartford and will be an upgrade over Martin as the third goaltender, behind Joonas Korpisalo and Dylan Garand.
